dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which skill should I focus on for my growth this year?
dialogue.zh: 今年的成长中，我应该专注于哪项技能？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: System design would help. I can mentor you through a small project.
dialogue.zh: 系统设计会有帮助。我可以通过一个小项目指导你。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thanks. Let's put a monthly check-in on the calendar.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我们在日历上安排每月一次的交流吧。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Good idea. We can review progress and adjust the plan together.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我们可以一起回顾进展并调整计划。

communication_goal: 讨论成长目标并安排指导与回顾。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two coworkers stand beside a large calendar sheet with blank square grid and no numbers. One points to a square while the other discusses thoughtfully. Full calendar visible, no text.

image_review.summary: 通过：完整立式日历与支架，职业成长与指导由对白说明。 前三词由对白提供语境证据，静态画面不能单独证明，不设局部框。 真实裁剪发现切边后按1254尺寸修正并增加6/1000边缘余量。
